title: ひとつのたね (Hitotsu no Tane)
description: A peaceful cumulative story about a single seed and the chain of life it sets in motion. A child plants a seed, which grows into a flower, which attracts a bee, which helps another flower make fruit, which feeds a bird, which carries a new seed — and the cycle begins again. Each new link in the chain is gently recapped as the story builds.
author: オリジナル
